# Decision Log — <phase or loop name>

> Per-phase (or per-loop) record of consequential decisions. Each entry serves
> two readers at once: advanced users scan the header + TL;DR; beginners expand
> for the why, the alternatives considered, and what to learn. `kbd-status`
> prints the header lines; `kbd-status --explain` expands the full entries.
>
> Written/appended by kbd-analyze, kbd-plan, pmpo-elicit, kbd-capability, and
> pmpo-outer-loop. Keep entries terse — this is a log, not an essay.

## D-001 · <decision in a noun phrase>          [<stage> · <YYYY-MM-DD>]

**TL;DR:** <one line: what was decided and the headline reason>

**Why:** <the deciding factors — evidence, constraints, fit. 1–3 sentences.>

**Alternatives:** <option A (why rejected)> · <option B (why rejected)>

**Learn more:** <pointer for a beginner — a doc section, an artifact path, a
candidate's evidence block, or a one-line concept to read up on>
